about: The owner names the system agent-os and asks to update every related file; asks whether everything about trading moved down to the trading agents, here the prediction-market domain, with any later trading domain templated from it; asks the page's .index.md filter to become a metadata filter that shows the metadata files too; says to continue with the plan, for now with empty meta documents for everything that has none; and wants metadata file names without the subject's format (extension), just the name.
changes_when: Never in the owner's words; only its answer and what it was processed into are added once its knowledge is placed.

update_with.how: Keep its row (summary, categories, processed_into, answered) the same as this file.
